Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller

Class WikiLintController

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller.WikiLintController
@RestController public class WikiLintController extends Object
REST controller for wiki lint operations.

Provides a manual trigger at POST /monitoring/wiki/lint and a latest-report endpoint at GET /monitoring/wiki/lint/latest. The path /monitoring/** is already permitAll() in SecurityConfig.
